data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 市集里的围巾试色
data.description: 市集布摊前，拉芙塔莉雅穿青绿长衫和米白马甲，将一条赭色围巾比在肩上。她低头看布料，再伸手摸摸毛绒耳边的边线，认真挑选不会扎人的织法，尾巴安静垂在身后。
data.action: 把围巾比在肩上，摸摸织边是否柔软。
data.promptProse: Standing before an open-air fabric stall in a bustling afternoon market wearing her teal tunic and cream laced waistcoat, Raphtalia drapes a woven ochre scarf carefully across one shoulder. Looking down at the cloth with a thoughtful gentle smile, she rubs the hem lightly between her fingers near her ear to test how soft the weave feels. Diffuse daylight beneath the canvas stall awning brightens the bolts of colored textiles behind her.
data.animaCaption: Standing before the sunlit market fabric stall in her teal tunic and cream waistcoat, Raphtalia holds an ochre scarf against her shoulder and tests the softness of its woven edge with her free hand. Diffuse daylight under the canvas awning lights the surrounding bolts of cloth.
